ios.desc:
Tired of the same alarm every morning? Get a real connection! The Wake Up Call Service delivers a friendly human wake up call right to your phone, ensuring you start your day motivated. We're more reliable than an alarm and a lot nicer. Plus, we're hiring! Turn your free time into side income. Callers can earn real cash just by spreading a little cheer.

Get Woken Up. Get Going.

Experience the difference of a friendly voice instead of a jarring beep. Get a personalized Reminder Call, a Motivational Check-in, or just a cheerful chat to get you out of bed. It’s all about starting your day right. Need a reminder for a meeting or medication? We've got you covered. Every new user gets 5 free calls to try out the personalized service with zero commitment!

Call and Earn Real Cash.

Looking for flexible side income? Sign up to be a caller and earn easy cash right from your phone! It's rewarding work. You get paid simply for doing something nice, helping others wake up and stay on track. If you're friendly, reliable, and speak fluent English, join our community today and turn your spare time into real money. Earn cash on your schedule by spreading a little joy.

Unlock your Best Morning. Go Premium.

Ready for maximum personalization? Upgrade to Premium and unlock powerful, specialized calls you can select every time. Choose custom topics like a Medication Reminder Call, a Goal-Oriented Check-in, a specific Meeting Reminder, or even a fun Birthday/Anniversary Call. Get the exact motivation and focus you need to conquer your day, every single time. Go Premium and stop just waking up, start winning your mornings! You get more calls per month, longer calls (up to 5 minutes long), and more.

android.desc:
Get friendly wake up calls from real people, without sharing your number. The Wake Up Call Service is what it sounds like - we're a service that helps you wake up in the morning. If you're looking for an alternative to a traditional alarm or alarm clock app, consider trying the Wake Up Call Service. 

Starting the day with friendly wake up calls can helps with lots of things! 

- Reduced stress and anxiety: waking up to a pleasant and friendly voice can help ease you into the day and reduce feelings of stress and anxiety often associated with jarring alarm clocks. 

- Improved emotional well-being: a positive wake-up experience can set the tone for a happier and more productive day by boosting your mood and promoting emotional well-being.

- Increased motivation: waking up feeling refreshed and positive can lead to increased motivation and productivity throughout the day. We can help inspire you if you want!

- Personalize experience: We will personalize your call however you want. The more you share about yourself or your ideal wake up call topic, the more we can personalize it to you.

- Improved sleep quality: a gentle and personalized wake-up call can help regulate your sleep cycle and promote better sleep quality over time. Better sleep = better waking hours.

- Human connection: wake-up calls from real people can foster a sense of connection and community, especially if you feel alone or isolated, or if you just lack connection with others.

Want a wake-up call with a specific theme, like motivation, news, or even a fun fact of the day? We've got you covered. Right now we only make calls in English, but more languages are coming soon!

No more fumbling with your phone in the morning to snooze an alarm. We make waking up effortless and enjoyable. Schedule your calls in advance, and we'll take care of the rest.

Download the Wake Up Call Service today and experience the difference a personalized wake-up call can make. Your first 5 calls are free, so you have nothing to lose!

quotes.text:
I'm still tinkering with my iOS/Android app.

It allows you to get a wake up call, like you would at a hotel, but from a real, friendly person somewhere around the world. If nobody is available to make your call, you'll get an automated call with a friendly recording.

All calls happen through the app so no phone numbers exchanged.
